Detailed balance gives log(a+/a-)=a/2+x,log(b+/b-)=a/2-x, cycle affinity a independent of voltage. Symmetry/coarse-graining of a real reaction are assumptions, not measurements. Large-population deterministic model, not atomistic/finite-site dynamics.

Strong-drive transition-state contrast must exceed state-charge contrast; if both barriers lie between state responses this symmetric model cannot gain. At equilibrium a0 Cr>0: no single-heat-bath work. This is not a universal multistate no-go.

Ordinary capacitance, leakage and useful load must all be overcome.

Hypothetical strong model1cm² gives load~579ohm and additional shunt~12.24microF at2kilohm, LINEAR boundaries not Pt expected values or nonlinear quenching proof. Retain equilibrium/reaction-blocked, matched-temperature, wiring/phase, dielectric transient and stored-electrical/chemical-inventory controls; product metrology closes free energy. Thermal/heater feedback, Faradaic shorts and hot-electron collection are alternatives, not confirmation.
